title: Micro collab rollup and quick metrics (mini-sprint)
content:
Purpose:
A compact sheet to surface short-lived asks and light metrics for the mid-week mini-sprint. Meant for quick syncs with SRE, Platform, SE, and Support. Use this as the single row-of-truth for on-the-day decisions; not a long-term tracker.

Snapshot (table view, top 6 rows):
Columns: Owner | Ask (one-line) | Severity | Blocking? (Y/N) | ETA hours | Timezone | Quick status | Next action
1) Priya N. | Finalize canary traffic split for route /v2/generate | high | Y | 6 | PDT | awaiting config PR review | @Ethan to approve PR by EOD
2) Ethan Z. | Increase kv-cache quota on ded-gn1 pool | medium | N | 3 | UTC | queued (ops change window) | schedule change 10/07 02:00 UTC
3) Maya P. | Quick eval run for quantized model shard | high | Y | 10 | CET | running (30% done) | escalate if >12h and failing
4) Lina S. | Customer onboarding test vectors (40 unique) | low | N | 2 | PDT | in progress | hand to SE for smoke test
5) DevOps team | Short-term routing fallback to region eu-west | medium | Y | 4 | CET | blocked (missing certs) | Liam to raise cert request ticket
6) Support | Spike in embedding errors (500 responses/day) | high | Y | 8 | PDT | investigating | collect sample requests + send to eng-observability

Quick metrics (one-line summaries):
- Total active asks: 6
- Blocking asks: 4
- Estimated combined ETA (hours): 33
- Owners across teams: product(2), eng(2), support(1), devops(1)
- Timezones represented: PDT, UTC, CET

Notes / heuristics:
- If an ask is blocking and ETA > 6h, escalate to on-call SRE + product lead.
- Use the "Quick status" column as the single source for meeting updates; avoid duplicating updates in Slack.
- For any change requiring infra window, annotate with exact UTC time and expected rollback step.

Draft action items (short):
- Ethan: approve config PR for canary and notify Priya when merged (due 2026-10-05 18:00 PDT).
- Liam: open cert request and link ticket here (due 2026-10-06).
- Maya: post run summary + failed prompt sample in observability channel (due 2026-10-06 09:00 CET).
- Priya: run final smoke against /v2/generate canary at +1h after merge and report latency delta.

Open questions / risks (notes-to-self style):
- If quantized shard eval shows >5% perf regression on tail latency, fallback plan? (option: revert to previous shard or reduce batch size).
- Cert provisioning timeline is uncertain; if delay >24h, pivot to manual routing rule in control plane.

Quick checklist for meeting handoff (two bullets):
- Confirm each blocking ask has an explicit owner + ETA in hours.
- Capture one-line final decision in this doc and paste to the cross-team channel after the sync.

History (changelog):
- 2026-10-05 created (Priya) initial rollup from morning sync
- 2026-10-06 updated (Ethan) added canary PR status and adjusted ETA for kv-cache
- 2026-10-07 updated (Maya) added eval progress and action to escalate on slow completions

Plain-text export tips:
- This sheet is intentionally small; if a row turns persistent (more than 3 days of activity), promote it to the longer-running tracker in /shared_drives/product/product-ops.

End of doc.
